name: – Anna Strolenberg – § 54
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: Urges the Commission and the Member States to take the necessary measures to fight anti-gender and anti-rights movements, including anti-LGBTIQ+ movements, and to conduct in-depth research, monitoring and analysis of the impact of these movements to gain a clearer understanding of their operations, coordination and financing strategies; stresses that such understanding is crucial to safeguard an inclusive and tolerant Europe grounded in the values enshrined in Article 2 TEU;
